name: Lumbridge Swamp Caves
accessNote: Caves beneath Lumbridge Swamp, entered by tying a rope to the hole east of the swamp; a light source is required and open flames are extinguished by the swamp gas. Home to cave bugs, cave slime, cave crawlers, rockslugs and wall beasts. A Dwarf multicannon can be used here. A spiny helmet is needed to safely attack wall beasts. Multi and safespot availability are not wiki-confirmed (conservative defaults).
